newsitem.title: USA: U.S. advisory panel urges more research on disabled.
newsitem.headline: U.S. advisory panel urges more research on disabled.

text.p: The U.S. government needs a new agency for research on the disabled, the private Institute of Medicine recommended on Tuesday.

"Federal efforts to improve the lives of people with disabilities are hampered by inadequate research funding and poor coordination among the many programmes involved," the non-profit Institute of Medicine said in a statement.
An advisory panel of the institute urged the formation of a new Agency on Disbility and Rehabilitation Research to raise awareness about new techniques and to fund research.
The institute said disabilities cost the United States more than $3 billion each year in medical costs and lost productivity.
The institute provides health policy advice under a congressional charter granted to the National Academy of Sciences.
